retrievalProfile.description: A sepia-toned group portrait of a five-member band against a textured off-white background with sharp, angular custom lettering at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia-toned composition featuring a band lineup in the lower two-thirds, set against a weathered, parchment-like background with aggressive, geometric display type centered at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subjects against a light, textured void
Horizontal band alignment creating a solid visual base
Angular, sharp-edged typography mirroring the edgy rock persona
Sepia palette unifying disparate clothing textures
coreInvariants: Heavy sepia or monochromatic brown tinting
Visible film grain and paper texture
Sharp, geometric letterforms with diagonal slashes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band members occupy the bottom 60% of the frame, scaled to appear as a unified group from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the band lineup provides the vertical axis for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharp typography at the top, move down to the central faces, and scan horizontally across the band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the top third surrounding the title text, featuring a distressed paper texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep sepia/near-black for shadows and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone brown for skin tones and textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark clothing and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Incorporate horizontal cross-bars that extend beyond the vertical stems
Maintain a consistent height with varying widths
Apply a distressed, hand-drawn texture to the edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: S-shape constructed from three straight diagonal segments
O-shape featuring a crosshair or diagonal slash through the center
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface to maintain focus on the band imagery.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, rock-and-roll energy of the original lettering.
Captures the raw, textured feel of the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned group portrait of five people in 1970s attire, positioned from the waist up against a textured, off-white parchment background with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom angular, geometric lettering in dark sepia at the top center, ensuring the letters have sharp terminals and a distressed texture.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Are the letterforms sharp and angular rather than rounded?
Is there a clear separation between the dark subjects and the light background?
Does the background have a weathered paper texture?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent sepia toning across all elements.
Ensure the typography feels integrated into the paper texture.
Verify the group composition feels like a single cohesive photograph.
Confirm the background texture is not overly repetitive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Group Portrait + Distressed Parchment + Angular Geometric Display Type
